feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Politics chat: Data centers are on everyone's minds going into Election Day
entry.summary: With days until Election Day, polls show momentum for Democratic candidates and bipartisan distaste for data centers.

entry.title: What NPR's senior political correspondent is watching for on Election Night
entry.summary: An NPR senior political editor/correspondent tells us what he will be looking out for as results roll in on Election Day.

entry.title: Living with high prices in Virginia's 1st Congressional District
entry.summary: High prices are straining budgets for both a small business owner and a single mom in a rural part of Va.'s 1st Congressional district. They explain how they're handling the economic stress of these times.

entry.title: It's ACA open enrollment time. Here are the changes for health insurance shoppers
entry.summary: The ACA health insurance marketplaces — find yours at HealthCare.gov — open Nov. 1 for 2027 coverage. Getting an early start may be especially important this year.

entry.title: How Gen Z Republicans running for Congress are thinking about the future of the party
entry.summary: On the eve of what may prove to be a tough election for the GOP, young conservatives vying to be part of the first class of Gen Z Republicans in Congress want a role shaping the party's next chapter.

entry.title: Trump thanks supporters for the memories in final campaign stops for 2026 midterms
entry.summary: President Trump has maintained a near-daily rally schedule as Election Day draws closer, playing his greatest hits for loyal crowds in red states in what is a sort-of goodbye to campaigning.

entry.title: Supreme Court hears religious freedom case centered on universal pre-K program
entry.summary: The Archdiocese of Denver wants to be able to turn away LGBTQ families from Catholic preschools that receive state funding.

entry.title: Here's how to watch election night as the polls close, hour-by-hour
entry.summary: As polls close on election night, here's a look at what to expect each hour and which midterm races are key to deciding control of Congress.

entry.title: What's it like to run for Congress when the odds are stacked heavily against you?
entry.summary: The majority of congressional races this cycle are rated either solid Democrat or solid Republican. They're the opposite of tossups, where candidates from the minority party face near impossible odds.

entry.title: 'Grasping at straws': Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter
entry.summary: Saying the president was "grasping at straws," a federal judge on Saturday threw out Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.
